plugins.description: Idle-aware time tracking for Claude Code, run locally: `setup` installs it, `launch` opens the dashboard (active hours, work calendar, token/tool usage, prompt-health). `deploy-vercel` optionally stands up a private, magic-link-gated hosted version. Your transcripts never leave your machine.
